name: Exp_DigVariation
summary: This EA trades based on the DigVariation custom indicator, which applies digital smoothing to a moving average. It opens buy positions when the smoothed value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于DigVariation自定义指标进行交易，该指标对移动平均线应用数字平滑处理。当平滑值向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于DigVariation指标的趋势跟踪系统。DigVariation指标通过数字平滑算法（0-10级平滑强度）对移动平均线进行处理，减少噪音并识别趋势转折点。入场条件：当指标值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当指标值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及反向信号平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额比例、基于净值比例等。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险报酬比为1:2，属于中长线趋势跟踪风格。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the DigVariation indicator. The DigVariation indicator applies a digital smoothing algorithm (0-10 smoothness levels) to a moving average, reducing noise and identifying trend reversal points. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator value turns from declining to rising (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell position is opened when the indicator value turns from rising to declining (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), as well as closing on opposite signals. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based proportion, equity-based proportion, etc. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points yields a risk-reward ratio of 1:2, consistent with a medium-to-long-term trend-following style.

pros: 使用数字平滑算法减少市场噪音，信号质量较高
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性好
止损止盈比率为1:2，具有正期望值潜力
IsNewBar机制避免同一K线重复交易
可独立控制多空开仓和平仓，策略配置灵活
pros_en: Digital smoothing algorithm reduces market noise and improves signal quality
Multiple money management modes provide good flexibility
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2 offers positive expectancy potential
IsNewBar mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same bar
Independent control over buy/sell opening and closing allows flexible strategy configuration
cons: 默认止损1000点过大，可能在剧烈行情中造成较大亏损
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不必要的交易
没有持仓数量检查，可能重复开仓导致过度暴露
依赖自定义指标DigVariation，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
信号逻辑简单，在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号
cons_en: Default 1000-point stop loss is large and may cause significant losses in volatile markets
No spread filter, potentially generating unnecessary trades in high-spread conditions
No position count check, risk of repeated entries leading to overexposure
Depends on the custom DigVariation indicator; EA fails if indicator file is missing
Simple signal logic may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets
improvements: 增加点差过滤器，避免在高点差时开仓
增加最大持仓数量限制，防止过度暴露
增加趋势过滤器（如大周期MA方向判断），减少震荡市中的虚假信号
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to avoid opening positions during high-spread conditions
Add maximum position count limit to prevent overexposure
Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 默认止损1000点较大，单笔亏损可能较高
缺少持仓数量检查，可能重复开仓导致风险叠加
没有点差过滤和波动率过滤，极端市场条件下风险不可控
risk_points_en: Default 1000-point stop loss is large, potentially causing high per-trade losses
No position count check may lead to risk accumulation from repeated entries
No spread or volatility filter makes risk uncontrollable under extreme market conditions
